test: [INV-SCH-04] falsifier: a 200-item backlog leaves the node byte-identical
what: A learner returns after three months to a 200-item due backlog against a 15-exercise session: more than thirteen sessions of arrears, so the node popup must lead with a review. The falsifier is the node itself changing — dropped items, re-weighting by due-ness, a shortened lesson — so that which lesson you get depends on how long you were away, with nothing on screen saying so.
measured: 2026-09-11. JSON.stringify of the node contents is byte-identical in both branches and equal to generateNodeContents(spec) called on its own; surfaceReviewFirst flips to true; the review slice is drawn entirely from the backlog and contains none of the node's own items.
